rules.effect_es: Es posible que te cases más de una vez.

rules.effect: Your marriage may bring you less happiness than you hope for.
rules.effect_es: Tu matrimonio podría darte menos felicidad de la que esperas.

rules.effect_es: Es posible que encuentres poca felicidad en tu vida de hogar y familia.

rules.effect: A high position you reach may, in the end, slip away from you.
rules.effect_es: Una posición elevada que alcances podría, al final, escapársete de las manos.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'ultimately'; gives no age or period. Book text reads 'in (or aspecting) the 9th and 10th'; only the in-house reading is encoded.

rules.effect: You feel things intensely and see matters in a very personal light, which can make fair-mindedness harder.
rules.effect_es: Sientes las cosas con intensidad y ves los asuntos de forma muy personal, lo que puede dificultar la imparcialidad.
rules.timing_note: Book speaks of the Moon in Scorpio (quoting Gleadow); in the grammar that is exactly the Moon debilitated.

rules.effect: You may struggle with mental tiredness, self-consciousness, feelings of inferiority, irritability and a deep-seated fear.
rules.effect_es: Es posible que luches con cansancio mental, autoconciencia excesiva, sentimientos de inferioridad, irritabilidad y un miedo profundo.

rules.effect: You are drawn toward sports, athletics or officer-level work in the forces and official services.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas hacia el deporte, el atletismo o el trabajo de oficial en las fuerzas y los servicios oficiales.
rules.timing_note: Source is a statistical finding about professionals (Gauquelin) read in reverse; 'angles' taken as the four kendras.

rules.effect: You are drawn toward a priestly or religious calling.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas hacia una vocación sacerdotal o religiosa.
rules.timing_note: Statistical finding about priests read in reverse; 'angles' taken as the four kendras.

rules.effect: You have the makings of a senior commander in military or official service.
rules.effect_es: Tienes lo necesario para ser un comandante de alto rango en el servicio militar u oficial.
rules.timing_note: Statistical finding about generals read in reverse; 'angles' taken as the four kendras.

rules.effect: You are drawn toward science and medicine.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas hacia la ciencia y la medicina.
rules.timing_note: Statistical finding about scientists and doctors read in reverse; 'zones of activation' taken as the four kendras.

rules.effect: You are drawn to philosophical work, writing or teaching for people who want to think deeply.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas hacia el trabajo filosófico, escribiendo o enseñando para quienes quieren pensar a fondo.
rules.timing_note: From the worked example of Emerson (Mercury in own sign in the 10th); own-sign not required here.

rules.effect: You are drawn to drama and fiction, writing for ordinary people.
rules.effect_es: Te inclinas hacia el teatro y la ficción, escribiendo para la gente común.
rules.timing_note: From the worked example of Lytton.

rules.effect_es: Llevas un temperamento de guerrero, atraído por mandar, proteger y defender, y por roles en la policía, el ejército o la política.
rules.timing_note: Stated in the book as completing the Mars-Saturn connection factor; offered as a tentative observation.

rules.effect: You show a commander's temperament in your career, taking charge and fighting for the people you lead.
rules.effect_es: Muestras un temperamento de comandante en tu carrera, asumiendo el mando y luchando por las personas que diriges.
rules.timing_note: Given for a head of state whose chart had this placement; the book treats it as the same Mars-Saturn connection factor.

rules.effect: You can keep up self-control and a steady practice with determination, even when many distractions pull at you.

rules.effect: You bring strong will and determination to your spiritual practice.

rules.effect: You have the tenacity to overcome obstacles.

rules.effect: Your health tends to stay sound.

rules.effect: In spiritual practice you develop one-pointed concentration.

rules.effect: You are drawn to worship in many forms and to deep study and writing of sacred texts.

rules.effect: Your visible deeds lean toward the sacred and ritual, and earn you social recognition.

rules.effect: You overcome your opponents.

rules.effect: You reach a good position in life with prosperity.
rules.effect_es: Alcanzas una buena posición en la vida con prosperidad.

rules.effect: You stick to the standards of behaviour you set for yourself.
rules.effect_es: Te mantienes en las normas de conducta que te fijas.

rules.effect: Your career shows rare resilience and survives intrigues against you.
rules.effect_es: Tu carrera muestra una resiliencia poco común y sobrevive a las intrigas en tu contra.

rules.effect: You speak the truth with a natural majesty.
rules.effect_es: Dices la verdad con una majestuosidad natural.

rules.effect: Comfort at home and prosperity are promised to you.
rules.effect_es: Se te promete comodidad en el hogar y prosperidad.

rules.effect: This exchange supports material prosperity and reaching high positions in life.

rules.timing_note: Book attributes this to the Hindu sages and reads the node by the house it occupies; written here as a whole-sign house reading.

rules.effect: You tend to have only a few children.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a tener pocos hijos.
rules.timing_note: Book attributes this to the Hindu sages and reads the node by the house it occupies; written here as a whole-sign house reading.

rules.effect: Your ambition and unconventional drive tend to work in your favour.
rules.effect_es: Tu ambición y tu impulso poco convencional tienden a trabajar a tu favor.
rules.timing_note: General rule the book gives from Kalidasa: the node is beneficial in these houses.

rules.effect: Your detached side tends to work in your favour.
rules.effect_es: Tu lado desapegado tiende a trabajar a tu favor.
rules.timing_note: General rule the book gives from Kalidasa: Ketu is favourable in this house.

rules.effect: You meet difficulties through officials and authority, with a risk of legal trouble and loss of position.
rules.effect_es: Encuentras dificultades con funcionarios y autoridades, con riesgo de problemas legales y pérdida de posición.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Sun and Rahu indicate' these troubles without saying conjunct; conjunction assumed.

rules.effect: You are troubled by worry, anxiety and feelings of inferiority.
rules.effect_es: Te inquietan la preocupación, la ansiedad y los sentimientos de inferioridad.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Moon and Rahu threaten' these without saying conjunct; conjunction assumed.

rules.effect: You are industrious, honest, patient and persevering.
rules.effect_es: Tienes una naturaleza laboriosa, honesta, paciente y perseverante.
rules.timing_note: Western view quoted by the book; both planets in these houses.

rules.effect: You have a strong appetite for learning.
rules.effect_es: Tienes un fuerte apetito por aprender.
rules.timing_note: Book says appetite to learn astrology; generalised to learning. Both planets in these houses.

rules.effect: You are drawn to astrology and the study of the stars.
rules.effect_es: Sientes atracción por la astrología y el estudio de los astros.
rules.timing_note: Book (Horasara): Moon in Cancer; Cancer is the Moon's only own sign so own-sign dignity is used. The book itself says not every such person will study astrology.

rules.effect: You express yourself clearly, with a rich vocabulary, quick grasp, good memory and fluent speech.
rules.effect_es: Te expresas con claridad, con vocabulario rico, comprensión rápida, buena memoria y habla fluida.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'good/favourable aspects'; only the trine (houses 1-5-9 from each other) can be written, so the rule fires on a subset of the book's condition.

rules.effect: You think with concentration and depth, and work in an exact, precise and methodical way.
rules.effect_es: Piensas con concentración y profundidad, y trabajas de forma exacta, precisa y metódica.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'good/favourable aspects'; only the trine (houses 1-5-9 from each other) can be written, so the rule fires on a subset of the book's condition.

rules.effect: You have a talent for mathematics and calculation.
rules.effect_es: Tienes talento para las matemáticas y el cálculo.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'good/favourable aspects'; only the trine (houses 1-5-9 from each other) can be written, so the rule fires on a subset of the book's condition.

rules.effect: You have a strong command of language and wide knowledge, which suits writing, editing and journalism.
rules.effect_es: Dominas bien el lenguaje y tienes un conocimiento amplio, lo que te favorece en la escritura, la edición y el periodismo.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'good/favourable aspects'; only the trine (houses 1-5-9 from each other) can be written, so the rule fires on a subset of the book's condition.

rules.effect: A business partnership is advisable for you, with a good working arrangement.
rules.effect_es: Una sociedad de negocios te conviene, con un buen acuerdo de trabajo.
rules.timing_note: Book: if the lords of the 1st and 7th are in harmonious aspect or exchange, partnership is advisable. Only the exchange is written. Book places this in the discussion of common signs but does not state it as a condition.

rules.effect: You find it hard to concentrate and you doubt yourself.
rules.effect_es: Te cuesta concentrarte y dudas de ti.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Moon afflicted by Saturn'. Its glossary (vol 1) defines affliction as adverse aspect or conjunction with a malefic; the conjunction is written here.

rules.effect: You tend to enjoy life comfortably even without performing special remedies or rituals.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a disfrutar la vida con comodidad aun sin hacer remedios o rituales especiales.
rules.timing_note: Book calls this the lightest kind of past-life burden. It also lists the running period lord joined with the Moon as a cause; that cannot be written.

rules.effect: Prayers, charity and remedies you perform bring you full relief from your troubles.
rules.effect_es: Las oraciones, la caridad y los remedios que haces te dan alivio completo de tus problemas.
rules.timing_note: Book: the lagna, Moon or running-period lord receiving a favourable aspect from Jupiter or the 9th lord marks an excusable past mistake, so remedies work in full. Period-lord case not written.

rules.effect: Important matters meet obstacles and delays, and often succeed only after more than one attempt.
rules.effect_es: Los asuntos importantes encuentran obstáculos y demoras, y a menudo solo salen bien después de más de un intento.
rules.timing_note: Book names this combination 'Punarpoo': Moon with Saturn in the same sign; the first favourable period then fails and the next one delivers.

rules.effect: You gain or profit through a brother or sister, an agency, or writing.
rules.effect_es: Ganas o te beneficias por medio de un hermano o hermana, una agencia o la escritura.
rules.timing_note: Book gives the general case first, then Saturn (brother helps but is thrifty) and Mars (help is sudden, brother extravagant) as variants.

rules.effect: A marriage is promised for you.
rules.effect_es: Un matrimonio está prometido para ti.
rules.timing_note: Frame of 'the 5th house' is not stated; read in the ordinary whole-sign frame.

rules.effect: Your younger brother, mother and father tend to benefit and prosper.
rules.effect_es: Tus hermanos menores, tu madre y tu padre suelen beneficiarse y prosperar.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'advantageous to' these relatives; read as exchange of signs between the lords of 6 and 12.

rules.effect: Your mother, spouse and elder brother tend to benefit and prosper.
rules.effect_es: Tu madre, tu pareja y tu hermano mayor suelen beneficiarse y prosperar.
rules.timing_note: Read as exchange of signs between the lords of 8 and 12.

rules.effect: Your children tend to benefit and prosper.
rules.effect_es: Tus hijos suelen beneficiarse y prosperar.
rules.timing_note: Read as exchange of signs between the lords of 6 and 8. Book elsewhere says this exchange favours the native only when both lords are malefics and the lagna is Gemini, Virgo, Aries or Scorpio.

rules.effect: You are protected, and your health and standing tend to improve.
rules.effect_es: Estás protegido, y tu salud y tu posición tienden a mejorar.
rules.timing_note: Book: the lord of the ascendant will invariably protect the native and improve health and position provided it is not in 6, 8 or 12.

rules.effect: If you run a business, this is a stretch to expand it and open new branches.
rules.effect_es: Si diriges un negocio, esta es una etapa para expandirlo y abrir nuevas sucursales.
rules.timing_note: Book conditions this on being a businessman, which the grammar cannot test; the condition is carried in the sentence. Book says it applies to anyone in business, in any sign.

rules.effect: If you run a business, this is a stretch to consolidate and concentrate rather than expand.
rules.effect_es: Si diriges un negocio, esta es una etapa para consolidar y concentrarte en lugar de expandir.
rules.timing_note: Same conditioning on being in business as the previous rule.

rules.effect: You are better suited to working for others than to running an independent business.
rules.effect_es: Te conviene más trabajar para otros que llevar un negocio independiente.

rules.effect: Money, popularity and reputation do not come easily to you.
rules.effect_es: El dinero, la popularidad y la reputación no te llegan con facilidad.

rules.effect: You may find it hard to keep household helpers for long.
rules.effect_es: Puede costarte conservar por mucho tiempo a quienes te ayudan en casa.

rules.effect: You do well with small animals, dairy and poultry work.
rules.effect_es: Te va bien con animales pequeños, lácteos y avicultura.

rules.effect: You have a creative spirit and skill with machinery and stonework.
rules.effect_es: Tienes espíritu creativo y habilidad con la maquinaria y el trabajo en piedra.

rules.effect: You may earn by trading tools, farm implements, pottery or drinks.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ganar comerciando herramientas, aperos agrícolas, cerámica o bebidas.

rules.effect: Your relationship with your mother may be strained.
rules.effect_es: Tu relación con tu madre puede ser tensa.

rules.effect: You tend to win in legal disputes.
rules.effect_es: Tiendes a ganar en disputas legales.

rules.effect: You can arrange credit or overdraft facilities easily.
rules.effect_es: Puedes conseguir créditos o sobregiros con facilidad.

rules.effect: You may work in finance, law, religious institutions or banking.
rules.effect_es: Puedes trabajar en finanzas, derecho, instituciones religiosas o banca.

rules.effect: You may gain through arts, music, painting, tailoring, silk, perfume or weaving.
rules.effect_es: Puedes ganar con las artes, la música, la pintura, la sastrería, la seda, los perfumes o el tejido.

rules.effect: You are likely to acquire vehicles or land.
rules.effect_es: Es probable que adquieras vehículos o terrenos.

rules.effect: You may stay short of money and keep borrowing, with your debts growing.
rules.effect_es: Puedes quedarte corto de dinero y seguir pidiendo prestado, mientras tus deudas crecen.

rules.effect: You may work in mining products, fuel or heavy manual labour.
rules.effect_es: Puedes trabajar con productos mineros, combustibles o trabajo manual pesado.

rules.effect: You lead naturally and do best as a manager, director or instructor.
rules.effect_es: Lideras con naturalidad y te desempeñas mejor como gerente, director o instructor.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Sun in Aries'; Aries is the exaltation sign, so exalted is used.

rules.effect: You have strong willpower and are not easily discouraged.
rules.effect_es: Tienes una voluntad fuerte y no te desanimas con facilidad.

rules.effect: You have a talent for planning, organising and managing.
rules.effect_es: Tienes talento para planificar, organizar y dirigir.
rules.timing_note: Book says 'Saturn in Aries'; Aries is Saturn's debilitation sign.

rules.effect: In loans and recoveries of money you may get only about half of what you expect.
rules.effect_es: En préstamos y recuperaciones de dinero puedes obtener solo la mitad de lo que esperas.
rules.timing_note: Book's aspect is degree-based KP; ordinary sign aspect used here. Applies to questions of borrowing or recovery.

rules.effect_es: Este es un periodo difícil que tiende a traer muchos resultados indeseables.
rules.timing_note: Author says it applies to organisations, countries and natal charts.
